synthesis: Add four filter-reactive metric cards above the Hits table. The four same-named dashboard widgets cannot be reused: they read clarity.hit_stats_daily, a per-org/per-day rollup with no plate/VIN/order/disposition/kit/client/lienholder/location dimension, so they structurally cannot answer a filtered question. New purpose-built header widgets on ListHits are required, sourcing counts from the SAME query the table uses.

scope.summary: New header widgets on ListHits wired to Filament's handleTableFilterUpdates() choke point, plus the HasClickableFilter bypass, computing counts over the same buildClickhouseQuery()/buildPostgresQuery() base via applyFiltersToTableQuery().
out_of_scope: Modifying the four existing Company Metrics dashboard widgets or clarity.hit_stats_daily — different question (org-wide, date-bucketed), architecturally unrelated
Adding deduped-by-plate 'unique' counting unless Q1 resolves that way
Changing the Hits filter definitions themselves — only reacting to them is in scope
Any change to hits_hot/hits_cold schema or the CDC/MV pipeline

acceptance_criteria.item: Four metric cards appear above the hits table: Live Hits, Direct Historical Hits, Staging Live Hits, Staging Historical Hits
Each card displays the filtered count and a secondary 'X total hits' label
acceptance_criteria.reason: Stat::make()->description(); exact meaning gated on Q1/Q2

acceptance_criteria.item: Cards update whenever any left-pane filter is applied, changed, or reset
acceptance_criteria.reason: handleTableFilterUpdates() choke point + the HasClickableFilter bypass

acceptance_criteria.item: Cards and table always reflect the same underlying filtered dataset
acceptance_criteria.reason: reuse applyFiltersToTableQuery() over the same base builder; branch on the same shouldUseClickhouse()

acceptance_criteria.item: Cards display correctly across all screen sizes without layout overflow
acceptance_criteria.reason: Filament header-widget responsive grid; CompanyMetricsOverview columnSpan precedent

questions.q: Reuse vs parallel for the four existing dashboard widgets
questions.answer: Cannot reuse — hit_stats_daily has no filter dimensions and the widgets are non-mounted data adapters. Build new; carry over only the visual convention.

questions.q: How does a Filament header widget get the page's live filter state here?
questions.answer: No ListRecords page in this app uses header widgets today. Use Filament's handleTableFilterUpdates() single choke point + a Livewire event, and ALSO hook HasClickableFilter::addFilter()/addQueryFilter(), which bypass it.

questions.q: Do both the ClickHouse and Postgres paths need the cards?
questions.answer: Yes — the cards must branch on the same shouldUseClickhouse() the table uses, or they desync for orgs without the clickhouse:hits flag.

questions.q: What does the secondary 'X total hits' number mean — an org-wide unfiltered grand total, or the same filtered set's raw non-deduped count under a deduped headline?
questions.answer: Same filtered set: the headline is the deduped count, the secondary is the RAW (non-deduped) hit count for the same filtered dataset. Matches the existing dashboard convention ->description(number_format($total).' total hits').

questions.q: If 'total hits' is filtered-but-non-deduped, what time window does it cover — the active Hit Date filter (defaults to today), or all time?
questions.answer: Follows the active Hit Date filter like every other filter. No special-casing — preserves the 'cards and table always show the same dataset' invariant.

questions.q: Should the new count apply FINAL on hits_cold? The table's own query does not, and hits_cold carries a documented ~1.33x un-merged duplicate residue for some orgs.
questions.answer: No FINAL. Match the table's existing query exactly, duplicates included. Cards and table must agree (AC-4); the ~1.33x hits_cold residue is pre-existing and out of scope for this ticket.

data_impact.mv_or_cdc_implications: none — read-only aggregate over existing tables

resource_envelope.trigger: new app/Clickhouse/Queries/*Query.php issuing an aggregate COUNT/GROUP BY over hits_hot/hits_cold on every filter change
resource_envelope.growth: largest single kit already ~7.7M of 318M rows; an org may own several
resource_envelope.allocation_sketch: per-request query cost, not per-process memory accumulation — the DEV-2342 per-org-loop failure class does not apply
unresolved: no latency measurement for a representative filtered aggregate against hits_cold at production scale — validate during build/QA (recorded as an open risk, not a blocker: oracle_status=ok and the driving-table cardinality IS measured)

notes: HasClickableFilter::addFilter()/addQueryFilter() bypass handleTableFilterUpdates() — hooking only the choke point silently violates AC-3 for filter chips
DateTogglesFilter hits.created_at defaults to 'today' — easy to overlook as a filter the cards must react to
project_hits_cold_unmergeable_duplicates: bare count() on hits_cold over-counts ~1.33x for some orgs; hits_hot is clean
DECIDED 2026-09-15: secondary number = raw count of the SAME filtered set; follows the date filter; no FINAL (match the table).

escalation.deep_path_skip_reason: All three open questions are product semantics (what 'total hits' means, its window, FINAL policy). N=3 blind candidates re-derive code facts the single pass already grounded and cannot answer a product question, so the fan-out would not change the gate. Recorded rather than silently skipped.
